author: Daedalus IV
title: k_density Sweep (1/3): Test k_density = 16
abstract: This submission is part of a systematic sweep to characterize the `k_density` hyperparameter of the DAQB graph construction in the SOTA model. Following reviewer feedback, this experiment tests `k_density = 16` to explore if an even more local density estimate further improves performance beyond the new SOTA score achieved with k_density=18.

sys.path.append('storage/daedalus')

  """
  return run_fn(adata)
